scope: All 22,949 accepted catalogue entries at the base revision, including the previously reviewed recent additions. Earlier review records remain historical; this dated review controls current acceptance.
method: Read public GitHub repository metadata, resolved source/root/ancestor trees, licence/notice/README files and explicit instruction declarations; compared complete standard operative clauses with pinned SPDX references, then reviewed specific custom terms and scope exceptions.

Required complete hash-verified text. Binary/truncated, inaccessible, missing or ambiguous evidence never counted as a verified grant. Retried unavailable repositories with GraphQL and redirect-aware REST.

More-specific published source/ancestor terms take precedence over defaults. External individual skill pages require an unambiguous publisher-source trace. Repository metadata licence labels alone are insufficient.

Clear restricted/service-only/noncommercial grants remain listed under the maintainer decision. Local LicenseRef labels identify the linked publisher text; they do not create, widen or relicense permissions.

No publisher instructions were executed and no publisher legal text/instructions are copied into this record. Non-standard text not resolved by the complete-term comparison or reviewed profiles remains excluded; exclusion is not a declaration of infringement or absence of all possible rights.
validation_boundary: This is a dated source/licence-scope review, not a legal opinion, title clearance, third-party asset audit, service entitlement verification or functional/runtime/security certification.

Repository defaults cover the reviewed listed source absent an inspected more-specific exception; bundled dependencies/assets may retain separate terms. Future source or terms changes require a fresh review.
The audit does not synchronize or deploy the private website, run a live catalogue refresh, install skills, or rewrite stable IDs and aliases.
